Chapter 665 - 665 Information; Stand Out!

Chapter 665 - 665 Information; Stand Out!

665 Information; Stand Out!

Even though the area of Jiangbei University had expanded by more than three times compared to a thousand years ago, reaching nearly 700 million square meters, it was still crowded today.

Looking up, one could see many people everywhere.

Of course, there were students from Jiangbei University, Xia University, and Western University.

In addition, there were also many spectators who had specially come to watch the joint examination.

Lin Fan, Xia Xue, and Li Dongqiang chatted as they walked.

Not long after, they arrived at the plaza.

This was the competition area of their Group 7.

The referees were either closing their eyes to rest, discussing in low voices, or observing carefully… Everyone was determined to achieve excellent results in this joint examination.

Therefore, even though there were hundreds of people present, there was no liveliness. On the contrary, it was very dull.

At this moment, a round-faced man walked over and said with a smile, “Are you Li Dongqiang, Xia Xue, and Lin Fan from Jiangbei University?”

“You know us?” Li Dongqiang asked in confusion.

The round-faced man pushed his black-rimmed glasses up the bridge of his nose and said, “To be exact, I know you all, or rather, I know everyone from the three major schools. This is because I have the information of everyone there.”

“I forgot to introduce myself. I’m Tian Zhiwu from Xia University.”

When Li Dongqiang heard this, his eyes moved slightly as he asked, “Do you really have everyone’s information?”

After all, the joint examination was a competition of strength.

If he knew about other people’s information, it would definitely be very beneficial to him.

“Of course!” Tian Zhiwu replied.

Then, he took out the foldable display screen and clicked on it.

After a while, a 3D projection appeared in front of him.

The page contained Li Dongqiang’s basic information.

[Li Dongqiang: Male]

[School: Sophomore at Jiangbei University]

[Mech Rating: C]

[Special Ability Level: D]

[Remarks: Extraordinary endurance, strength, willingness to help others…]

Then, he displayed Xia Xue’s basic information.

[Xia Xue: Female]

[School: Sophomore at Jiangbei University]

[Mech Rating: C]

[Special Ability Level: D+]

[Remarks: Special flying ability, allowing her to be invincible at the beginning of the battle…]

Tian Zhiwu and Li Dongqiang could not help but look at Xia Xue.

D+ and flying ability. These were very rare among ordinary students.

Finally, Lin Fan’s information appeared on the 3D projection.

[Lin Fan: Male]

[School: Sophomore at Jiangbei University]

[Mech Ability: C]

[Special Ability Level: D]

[Remarks: Balance of strength, stability, and sustainable development…]

“How about it? Do you want me to check anyone’s information? A piece of information only cost 200 World Coins. Isn’t that a good deal? In addition, as long as you purchase more than three people’s information, you’ll be given a list of all the participants in Group 7.” Tian Zhiwu chuckled.

Lin Fan’s lips twitched.

People from a thousand years later did not seem to be as simple-minded as Zhang Wenzhuo.

Li Dongqiang thought for a moment and said, “Then give me the information of the three strongest people in the Group 7. Remember, you have to exclude the three of us.”

“Alright!” Tian Zhiwu said happily.

Then, the information of three people appeared in front of him.

[Song Kai: Male]

[School: Third year student of Western University]

[Mech Ability: B]

[Special Ability Level: D+]

[Remarks: His mecha abilities far exceed his peers, making him invincible…]

…

[Qin Zifeng: Male]

[School: Fourth year student of Jiangbei University]

[Mech Ability: C+]

[Special Ability Level: C]

[Remarks: Mecha and special ability levels put him among the best among his peers…]

…

[Lei Hu: Male]

[School: Junior year student of Xia University]

[Mech Ability: C-]

[Special Ability Level: B+]

[Remarks: Breaking all techniques with strength, a rare genius…]

…

“Lei Hu’s special ability is B+!” Li Dongqiang was surprised.

Among the other students who did not even have a B grade, a B+ grade was too eye-catching.

“Yes!” Tian Zhiwu said. “He’s the number one genius of our university! Let me remind you, his father is Lei Sen!”

“The master of the Thunderbolt Fist Dojo?” Li Dongqiang’s eyes widened.

“That’s right!” Tian Zhiwu.

“Hiss!” Li Dongqiang could not help but gasp.

This was truly too shocking.

Lei Sen was already extremely famous.

Not long ago, he appeared on the Strength Rankings, which made his reputation reach its peak.

They were actually competing on the same stage as Lei Sen’s son!

A low voice sounded behind him.

“Don’t you have eyes?” A man with long bangs looked at Tian Zhiwu from the corner of his eyes.

As soon as he finished speaking, he raised his thick arm and was about to push Tian Zhiwu to the side.

Tian Zhiwu seemed to have noticed this from the corner of his eye, and his body tilted slightly.

Unfortunately, he was still a step too late.

A huge force struck and directly flipped Tian Zhiwu onto the ground.

“What are you doing?” Tian Zhiwu said angrily.

However, when he saw the appearance of the man with long bangs, he was slightly stunned.

It was as if he had seen a ferocious beast and could not help but take half a step back.

“What? You have a problem with that?” The man with long bangs frowned.

Before Tian Zhiwu could reply, Li Dongqiang took a step forward and said, “What right do you have to push him? Apologize to him now!”

“You want to stand up for him?” asked the man with long bangs.

“Apologize!” Li Dongqiang said directly.

The man with long bangs snorted and pushed Li Dongqiang again.

Li Dongqiang had already seen his opponent’s move. He knew that his strength was far beyond that of ordinary people and that he could not be defeated.

Hence, he quickly dodged to the side.

However, even though he dodged the man’s arm, he still suffered an invisible force.

Li Dongqiang was like a kite with a broken string. He somersaulted in the air before slowly stabilizing his body.

Tian Zhiwu hurriedly walked up and said with concern, “Are you alright?”

After all, Li Dongqiang was only trying to stand up for him.

“He’s Zhao Ting, a student of Xia University. His ability is air manipulation. His level is C-! He has a fiery temper. We’d better not provoke him.”

Li Dongqiang was slightly shocked.

His grade was C-, and he could control the air!

Although this person called Zhao Ting was domineering, he was really strong!

Li Dongqiang’s expression changed, as if he was hesitating and considering something.

Xia Xue, who was next to him, said angrily to Zhao Ting, “You suddenly knocked someone away, and you’re still quibbling? Hurry up and apologize!”

Lin Fan did not say anything. He just took half a step forward and vaguely protected Xia Xue behind him.

In fact, with his strength, even if he was thousands of kilometers away from Xia Xue, it was impossible for Xia Xue to get hurt.

It was unnecessary for him to be concerned.
